_comment: Verdicts of the Python comparator this package replaced, measured by
running it over every case below; never hand-derived. Frozen: generated once
by a script that is not kept in the repository.
compare: "python" is the measured verdict, or "crashed" (a traceback, which
exited 1 and read as a finding) or "could-not-run". go_refuses marks an
input Go exits 2 on although Python answered.
run_to_run: lines are stdout with each rendered value replaced by …,
because Go renders values differently by design.
corrected: where Go deliberately departs from Python, the verdict it must
reach instead -- not measured, since Python cannot measure a fix to itself.

corrected.why: an absent leaf is compared by its absence, not as the string "<absent>"
a bool equals only a bool; Python had true == 1
logs compare by count: the second copy has nothing to pair with
